strings.name: Bernard Arnault
strings.role: LVMH leader · Luxury and brand management
strings.summary: Bernard Arnault moved from construction into brand management, expanding LVMH through acquisitions, integration and long-term investment. The group combines fashion, leather goods, jewelry, wines and retail while maintaining individual brands’ identities. His influence includes the consolidation of luxury businesses and debates about family control, corporate governance and cultural patronage.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026. The timeline includes major milestones through 2024, with 2026 management reporting also checked. Group achievements reflect team contributions; fluctuating wealth rankings are excluded.
strings.influence.rationale: Developed LVMH into a multi-brand luxury group, advancing global integration in fashion, jewelry, wines and retail.

strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: Building a multi-brand group
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Led LVMH from 1989, expanding its international business through brand integration.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: Cultural patronage
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Initiated the Fondation Louis Vuitton art venue, opened to the public in 2014.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: Elected to French academy
strings.timeline.event-1.text: Joined the Political Economy, Statistics and Finance section of the Academy of Moral and Political Sciences.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: Tiffany acquisition completed
strings.timeline.event-2.text: LVMH completed its acquisition of Tiffany, expanding the jewelry business.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Foundation opens to visitors
strings.timeline.event-3.text: The Fondation Louis Vuitton opened in Paris in a building designed by Frank Gehry.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Bulgari joins LVMH
strings.timeline.event-4.text: The group acquired Bulgari, further developing jewelry and watchmaking.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: Begins leading LVMH
strings.timeline.event-5.text: Became the group’s principal controlling shareholder and its chairman and CEO.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: Moves into luxury brands
strings.timeline.event-6.text: Reorganized Financière Agache, developing the business around Christian Dior.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: Graduates and joins family business
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Graduated from École polytechnique and began as an engineer at Ferret-Savinel.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: Born in Roubaix
strings.timeline.event-8.text: Born into an industrial family in northern France.
